How it works

Four steps. You only ever do one of them.

1
Tell us who you want

Describe your ideal customer in plain words. We build the targeting — no builder to learn.

2
Review the leads

Milla delivers matches with a "why they fit". You 👍 the good ones — reviewing is free.

3

The moment you approve, FIGSY writes, sends and follows up on your own warmed inbox.

4
Meetings get booked

Interested replies turn into calls, straight into your calendar. That's the outcome you pay for.
